t: Ergonomic DEWALT DCD778M1T-SFGB 18V combi drill featuring brushless motor and XR technology. Provides up to 65Nm torque for reliable performance on tough materials, and includes 13mm metal chuck and 2-speed variable transmission for versatility across wood, metal, and masonry. The ergonomic soft-grip handle, LED worklight, and spindle lock make it easy to use in tight or low-light spaces. Suitable for consistent screwdriving into a variety of materials with different screw sizes. Supplied with 4.0Ah XR battery with battery life indicator, charger and TSTAK compatible carry case for portability and convenience.
